Folders & Labels has visible mailbox cards and a mailbox selector for Gmail, Outlook, Yahoo and generic IMAP. A shared browser preserves real hierarchy, server delimiters, read-only folders and container parents. New folder and New child folder review the exact mailbox and destination; account and folder context menus also offer creation. Reviews are retired when the mailbox incarnation, folder identity or navigation changes. Gmail API user-label deletion requires typing confirm exactly, keeps messages and child labels, and waits 30 seconds before any removal. Undo deletion cancels during that grace period; it does not restore original label memberships after removal. Pending deletion pauses after restart and can be cancelled. Changing the mailbox connection cancels proven pre-write intents; earlier running or uncertain writes remain visible for manual provider review and never replay. Failed or uncertain writes never replay automatically. If durable folder recovery cannot open, browsing stays available and folder changes are disabled with an explanation. IMAP, Outlook, Yahoo and legacy Gmail IMAP deletion remain disabled until genuine recovery can be verified; no irreversible delete is substituted. Existing Gmail/Outlook permissions, rename, nesting and message actions remain under provider tools. Local Folders retain their separate creation, import and empty-folder context controls; empty local-folder deletion has no Undo. No new bot or CLI command is added. Native provider behavior, operating-system screen readers and real power-loss recovery require separate verification.
